origin.municipalVerticalPlacement: not a source vertical datum; hero bases are explicitly authored placements using interpreted 2023 terrain

glb.validated: GLB v2 container and Trimesh reload; finite geometry; source mesh count matched

usd.validated: Parsed with usd-core; mesh counts, Y-up metres, explicit collision APIs, 20 kg body, physics material bindings and hole-preserving static mesh approximations checked
usd.runtimeValidation: not run in Isaac Sim, Unreal or Unity; this is an authored interchange scene, not a certified simulator

provenance.summary: 168 municipal reference forms; 3 with authored components; bounded 2023 ground terrain; no extracted Google imagery or invented photo matches
provenance.municipal: City of Toronto 2025 release: site-plan heights or 2015 LiDAR-derived heights; actual per-feature observation date unknown
provenance.lidar: TRCA / Natural Resources Canada, GTA_2023; cropped GPS timestamps 11 April 2023; filename date 11 May is project acquisition endpoint
provenance.authored: Façade finishes, roof caps, windows, doors, steps, sidewalk/curb, test lane, trees and barrier are authored assumptions; no video registration or current-site verification
provenance.physics: Static triangle meshes preserve courtyard holes; one configured 20 kg movable barrier; material coefficients are test settings
limitations: No building interiors; doors are decorative and not traversable.
Municipal site-plan forms can differ from the 2023 LiDAR and the current site.
2 m terrain is interpolated from classified-ground returns; it does not measure curbs or small obstacles.
Context building bases outside the test patch use a flat zero baseline.
GLB contains visuals, IDs and provenance; explicit physics and semantic APIs are in OpenUSD.
The phone video remains a separate, unregistered reference.
